title: Keyhoe: Air Force tracked two unknown satellites in 1953
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Keyhoe: Air Force tracked two unknown satellites in 1953, about 1953 at Low Earth orbit, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Keyhoe states something astonishing, that the Air Force was tracking two unknown artificial satellites 400 and 600 miles up in low Earth orbit.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a claim from Donald Keyhoe, a writer who wrote about UFOs in the 1950s. According to Michels, Keyhoe stated that in 1953 the US Air Force was tracking two unknown artificial satellites circling the Earth, one about 400 miles up and the other about 600 miles up. If true, it would mean something made by no known country was orbiting the planet years before anyone had launched a satellite.
